name: Toya Shiori
source: [url=/c45153]Mio's[/url] maid coming from the Toya family, who have served the Yunoki family for a longer time. She has been with Mio ever since she was young, and the two are like sisters; sometimes they even get mistaken as a pair of siblings. She is willing to do anything for her dear Mio. Despite her relaxed nature she is proficient in all kinds of household chores.
